title: 3EN Network Autopilot - install and start persistent supervisor
description: Install the persistent Router/Pi-hole -> Privacy autopilot, register logon startup, start it immediately, and verify that it is alive. Future failed stages are repaired by updating the GitHub control generation/revision; no manual project restart is required.
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';Start-Sleep 3;$task=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Network Autopilot' -ErrorAction Stop;if($task.State -notin @('Running','Ready')){throw ('AUTOPILOT_TASK_STATE='+$task.State)};$log='C:/3EN-Agent/network-autopilot/autopilot.log';if(-not(Test-Path $log)){throw 'AUTOPILOT_LOG_MISSING'};$c=Get-Content $log -Raw;if($c -notmatch '3EN Network/Privacy Autopilot v1 started'){throw 'AUTOPILOT_START_MARKER_MISSING'};Write-Host ('NETWORK_AUTOPILOT_TEST=PASS;TASK_STATE='+$task.State)
rollback: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';Stop-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Network Autopilot' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Network Autopilot' -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;Write-Host 'NETWORK_AUTOPILOT_BOOTSTRAP_ROLLED_BACK'
